buyerCriteria.title: Buyer Criteria
buyerCriteria.description: Used by the AI to qualify companies before they become leads. Edit the common fields here, or open Advanced to edit the full criteria directly.
buyerCriteria.keywordsHelp: Comma-separated. Words that describe the buyers you want to reach.
buyerCriteria.unrepresentable: This value has an unexpected format and can only be edited in Advanced.
buyerCriteria.duplicatedKeysWarning: These are already separate fields above, so scoring will see them twice:
buyerCriteria.advancedHelp: The guided fields are disabled while editing raw JSON. Choose Apply to use your changes.
buyerCriteria.applyFirst: Apply or cancel your JSON changes before saving.
buyerCriteria.mustBeObject: Buyer criteria must be a JSON object, for example { "keywords": [] }.
buyerCriteria.saveError: Could not save — please try again.
buyerCriteria.testHelp: Scored against a few companies from the pool. Nothing is saved and no leads are created.
buyerCriteria.testEmpty: No companies available to test against.

emailTemplate.title: Email Template
emailTemplate.description: Your base outreach email. The AI personalises the opening for each company but keeps your pitch intact.
emailTemplate.subject: Subject
emailTemplate.notesPlaceholder: May personalise the opening paragraph, but must not change pricing claims.
emailTemplate.notesHelp: Guardrails the AI must follow when personalising. Not sent to the recipient.
emailTemplate.unknownPlaceholder: isn't a supported placeholder and will appear as-is in the email.
emailTemplate.spacedPlaceholder: has extra spaces and will appear as-is. Write it without spaces.
emailTemplate.queuedWarning: emails were already queued with the previous template and will still be sent as-is.
emailTemplate.campaignNote: Campaigns can override this template with their own version.
emailTemplate.previewHelp: Placeholders filled with a sample company and your configured sender name.

sendingIdentity.title: Sending Identity
sendingIdentity.description: The name and address your outreach is sent from. Configured by TargetOut as part of your domain and deliverability setup, so it can't be changed here.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how TargetOut AI looks on this device.

autoApprove.title: Auto-Approve Threshold
autoApprove.description: Optionally auto-approve AI-scored leads at or above a score, skipping manual review for your best matches.
autoApprove.thresholdHelp: Leads scoring at or above this value are approved automatically instead of entering the review queue.
